game.name: Super Mario 64 Category Extensions
game.rules:
## General Rules

Video is required for all new submissions, the video quality must be sufficient to verify that the objectives of the category are satisfied.

Unless explicitly stated, all category extensions follow the same "rules" as 16 star, meaning SBLJ or any form of skipping the 30 star door other than MIPS clipping is banned.

## Emulator

Emulator submissions follow the same restrictions as the main leaderboards. Check the rules on the main leaderboards, if you need help setting up Project64, check the emulator setup guide: https://wermi.neocities.org/emuguide/

## Codes

For categories which allow codes, ONLY the listed codes are allowed to be active. Any extra codes, even cosmetic ones, are not allowed. Abusing unintended effects caused by the codes to gain advantages in a run is generally banned.

relatedGames.name: Super Mario 64
relatedGames.rules:
**IMPORTANT:** To see specific rules for N64/VC/EMU subcategories, check the 'Category Rules' tab as well.

## Video Requirements:

All submissions requires a full video of the run, including game audio. 

## 

- The whole run should be in one segment
- Game audio must be audible (runs may be accepted with the 'Verified: No' flag for: extremely low game audio, constant music playback, and other related avoidable situations)
- The video link MUST embed on the run page (e.g. no URL shorteners or sketchy file sharing sites)
- VODs should persist indefinitely (e.g. Highlight instead of Past Broadcast)
- Dynamic HUD elements should not be obscured or omitted (e.g. coin count, star count, life count)

## Auto-rejection (SM64 Moderation Bot):

We use a bot to auto-reject runs which do not fill out the submission forms correctly, since we can't perform data validation via the submission form. If your run is auto-rejected, simply edit the submission with the fixes and resubmit the run. This has no bearing on the validity of your run (which may or may not be rejected for other reasons).

To avoid auto-rejection:

- Do not include milliseconds in your final time.
- Make sure the Platform matches the Platform subcategory (N64/VC/EMU)
- Make sure you highlight your twitch VOD.
- Leave the "Verified" flag set to "Yes"

## Good Faith Submissions

Runs are expected to be performed in good faith and may be rejected based on mod discretion if performed otherwise.  Examples include, but are not limited to: extended stalling to achieve a specific time; intentionally attempting to get the last place time on the leaderboard and/or the longest time possible; or attempting to exploit technicalities in the written category rules in a manner contrary to the spirit of the category. This means that long runs and/or runs with breaks will be considered in good faith so long as effort is still being made.

categories.name: Nonstop
categories.rules:
Timing starts at file select and ends once you collect the big star from the final bowser fight.  VODs are required for all new submissions.

The best way to do nonstop runs is using the preset in the Usamune practice ROM (MISC > PRESET > NONSTP). Otherwise you must apply the  "intro skip" and "nonstop" gameshark codes to the Super Mario 64 ROM. The "soft reset" code may be used to reset the game without having soft reset the game (and reapply the codes).

The coin counts for each stage must be saved by collecting a star after collecting every coin in the stage. 100 coin stars may be collected as well to save the coin count, but make sure you get every coin in the stage before you collect the star. This is how the game saves your coin count. When you pause in the castle, or look at the score screen on the file select screen, you should be able to see max coin scores. It is not necessary to show the pause screen or scoreboard at the end of the run, just make sure to grab a star after collecting all the coins in a stage. Timing starts on reset and ends when you touch the final star after defeating bowser. Side BLJ is banned.  VODs are required for all new submissions

categories.name: All Enemies
categories.rules:
Every enemy that you can kill/defeat in the game must be defeated, including ones that don’t give you coins. Includes all minibosses.

Enemies that respawn (such as bobombs, moles, and snowmen) must only be killed once

As per Ukikipedia, there are only two unique moles in TTM and 1 in HMC, so only that count must be killed in each. You must get both individual moles in TTM, but it's easy to track the one you don't get first.

Enemies that can’t be killed (thwomps, CCM bridge snowmen) can be ignored.

Enemies, like bobombs, that can explode on their own, must be triggered by the player and must visibly or audibly die in the run. If you trigger a bobomb and it doesn’t explode before you die or exit course, it doesn’t count. Also, if one gets hit by the bubbles in BOB, it also doesn't count.
-The only exception to this is the player throwing an enemy off the stage or a bobomb chasing off the edge after being triggered. They will die/explode on impact, and thus can be safely assumed to be killed. This is only because the death plane they eventually die on is usually out of visible/audible range. This is only true if sufficient time has passed before exiting the level after they fall.

All other enemies must be killed by physical contact. Running into lava or water after the player and dying, even while in aggro, doesn't count.

Any enemies that fall off the stage on their own must still be killed by the player. They can sit on the death plane, and thus cannot be assumed to be dead just from that. This typically would require a stage reentry.

Enemy list: https://shorturl.at/CJN14

categories.name: 100 Unique Lives
categories.rules:
Collect 96 unique 1-up tokens to reach 100 lives.

Timing starts at power on and ends when you collect the final bowser star. Side BLJ is banned. The life counter must be at 100 when you finish the run. If you lose a life, you may replace it by getting a 1-up that you already collected. Otherwise, no 1-up may be collected more than once.  VODs are required for all new submissions

Lives obtained from collecting 50/100/150 coins and then getting a star to exit the stage count for 1/2/3 lives respectively, but if you already got 2 lives from collecting 100 coins, then you may not collect 50 coins to get another life. The life counter increments per 50 coins you get, so getting 100 coins means you already got the 1-up from collecting 50 coins as well. Similarly, if you collected the 1-up from getting 50 coins, and then entered the same stage and got 100 coins, it would only count as 1 additional 1-up.

1up locations may be found here: http://www.sm64.com/

Get the star “Blast Away the Wall” in Whomp’s Fortress ten times. You may not use cannons. You may start from a pre-made file.

Timing starts on star select and ends when you grab the tenth star. You can have codes active that do not affect gameplay, but you can only use level reset/star select code to restart each attempt. VODs are required for all new submissions.

categories.name: 10x DDD Skip
categories.rules:
Starting from the center of the lobby carpet (initial position from exiting a stage), perform DDD skip ten times, each time exiting out of Fire Sea back to the lobby.

Timing starts on first movement and ends on the first frame the lobby is visible again after stage exiting from Fire Sea.

Your file should be such that the Fire Sea entrance is not accessible. The practice rom Usamune is allowed. The use of a speed display is banned.

games.name: Super Mario 64 Category Extensions
games.rules:
## General Rules

Video is required for all new submissions, the video quality must be sufficient to verify that the objectives of the category are satisfied.

Unless explicitly stated, all category extensions follow the same "rules" as 16 star, meaning SBLJ or any form of skipping the 30 star door other than MIPS clipping is banned.

## Emulator

Emulator submissions follow the same restrictions as the main leaderboards. Check the rules on the main leaderboards, if you need help setting up Project64, check the emulator setup guide: https://wermi.neocities.org/emuguide/

## Codes

For categories which allow codes, ONLY the listed codes are allowed to be active. Any extra codes, even cosmetic ones, are not allowed. Abusing unintended effects caused by the codes to gain advantages in a run is generally banned.
